body: # PARAMETERS (edit these; everything below refers to them)
Scaffold the minimal project from the reference `samples/minimal/`, following `scaffolding.md`.
# PARAMETERS (edit these; everything below refers to them)
PG_MAJOR      = ${9:18}            # PostgreSQL major, e.g. 18; pinned in the manifests
Scaffold the web service with PostgreSQL and a db-mgmt Job from the reference `samples/web-db/`, following `scaffolding.md`. Scope is exactly its three workloads: `db`, `db-mgmt`, `web-server`.
# PARAMETERS (edit these; everything below refers to them)
BLOCK         = ${1:echo-server}       # kebab-case; used for the block, manifest, image, crate dir and pod label
Resolve every value not listed here from the existing project, then `parameters.md`. Never copy names from samples.
Add the service `BLOCK` to this project per `services.md`.
End with exactly: `cargo generate-lockfile && cargo clippy --workspace --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && ./check.sh && ./k3d.sh build && ./k3d.sh deploy`
# PARAMETERS (edit these; everything below refers to them)
REALM         = ${1:staging}                   # realm name; also the overlay directory
PROFILE       = ${4:none}                      # cloud CLI profile, or none
Add the realm `REALM` to this project by reproducing `samples/web-db-staging/` with these parameters, following "Realm reference" in `scaffolding.md` and "Adding a realm" in `environments.md`.
Audit this project per `audit.md`. Do not modify any file.
